MAZDOCK: Execution Gains On New Frigate Deliveries Will Support Long-Term Upside
news.body: Analysts have slightly increased their fair value estimate for Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, raising the price target from about ₹2,768 to roughly ₹2,801 as they factor in updated assumptions for the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E multiples. What's in the News A board meeting was held on April 30, 2026, to review audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, and to consider the final dividend and other business matters.

news.title: MAZDOCK: Commissioning Progress And Dividend Stream Will Support Future Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts have adjusted their price target on Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders slightly lower to ₹3,380 from ₹3,407. The revision reflects updated assumptions for a 7.69% revenue growth rate, a 19.29% profit margin, a 13.55% discount rate and a future P/E of 58.51x.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues and EPS in line with analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹64.04 (up from ₹59.83 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹141.5b (up 24% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹25.8b (up 7.0% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 18% (down from 21% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) were also in line with analyst expectations. Revenue is forecast to grow 6.4% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 16% growth forecast for the Aerospace & Defense industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 23% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 90% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: MAZDOCK: Efficiency Gains And Dividend Policy Will Support Balanced Long-Term Outlook
news.body: The analyst price target for Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders has been adjusted slightly higher to about ₹2,768 from roughly ₹2,732, with analysts pointing to updated assumptions on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E as the key drivers of this change. What's in the News INSTaragiri, an indigenously built stealth frigate under Project 17A, has been commissioned into the Indian Navy at Visakhapatnam, highlighting Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders’ role in India’s defense shipbuilding program (Client Announcement).

news.title: MAZDOCK: Interim Dividend Stream Will Support Future Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts have kept the fair value estimate for Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders steady at ₹3,407, citing only modest updates to assumptions such as the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E that were not material enough to shift the overall price target. What's in the News The Board approved a 2nd interim dividend of ₹7.5 per equity share of ₹5 each, fully paid up, for the financial year 2025-26 at its meeting on 5 Feb 2026 (company announcement).

news.title: MAZDOCK: Dividend Payouts Will Support Future Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders by ₹82 to ₹3,407, reflecting updated assumptions for discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E. What's in the News The Board approved a 2nd interim dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share of face value ₹5 for the financial year 2025-26, signalling another cash payout to shareholders for the year (company announcement).

news.title: MAZDOCK: Naval Maintenance MoU And Dividend Will Support Measured Long-Term Order Upside
news.body: The analyst fair value estimate for Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders has been revised from ₹2,975 to ₹2,731.80, with analysts citing updated assumptions on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E to justify the change. What's in the News The Board approved a 2nd interim dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share of face value ₹5 for FY 2025-26.

news.title: Price target decreased by 8.2% to ₹2,732
news.body: Down from ₹2,975, the current price target is an average from 5 analysts. New target price is 21% above last closing price of ₹2,252. Stock is up 7.1% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹69.97 for next year compared to ₹59.83 last year.

news.title: MAZDOCK: Naval Maintenance MoU Will Support Long-Term Defence Order Upside
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders steady at ₹2,975, adjusting their view mainly through a slightly lower discount rate, modestly softer revenue growth assumptions, a marginally higher profit margin outlook, and a small tweak to future P/E expectations. What's in the News The board approved a 2nd interim dividend of ₹7.5 per equity share of face value ₹5 for FY 2025-26, with payment scheduled on or before 07 March 2026 (company filing).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹21.81 (up from ₹20.01 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹38.6b (up 23% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹8.80b (up 9.0% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 23% (down from 26% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.8%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 31%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Aerospace & Defense industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 28% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 88% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: MAZDOCK: Upcoming Navy MoU Benefits Will Support Future Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts now set their price target for Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders at ₹3,489, down from ₹3,858. This reflects updated assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E.

news.title: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd. Announces Resignation of Chandu Sambasiva Rao as Independent Director, Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd. has announced that Shri Chandu Sambasiva Rao has resigned from the position of Independent Director of the Company due to personal reasons and unavoidable circumstances. The date of cessation is January 23, 2026.

news.title: MAZDOCK: New Naval Partnerships Will Drive Long-Term Defence Order Upside
news.body: Analysts have maintained their fair value estimate for Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders at ₹2,975.00 per share, with only minor technical adjustments to inputs such as the discount rate, revenue growth assumptions, profit margin and future P/E informing this unchanged target. What's in the News Brazilian Navy and Indian Navy signed an MoU with Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders on 9 December 2025 covering information exchange on maintenance of Scorpene class submarines and other military ships, including cooperation on procurement opportunities, defence industry experience sharing, and research and development partnerships (Client Announcements).

news.title: MAZDOCK: Navy Landing Dock Partnership Will Support Future Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders slightly to ₹2,975 from ₹3,020, reflecting updated assumptions for revenue, profit margins, discount rate and future P/E multiples. What's in the News Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders signed an exclusive teaming agreement with Swan Defence and Heavy Industries at India Maritime Week 2025 in Mumbai for collaboration on designing and constructing Landing Platform Docks for the Indian Navy (Key Developments).
